item.title: Mohamed Salah tears into Liverpool and sensationally suggests he'll leave after being snubbed in Leeds draw

item.title: Tourists among dead as 23 killed in Indian nightclub fire

item.title: Home Office admits 170 terrorists cannot be deported from Britain due to human rights laws
item.description: Human rights laws are blocking the deportation of dozens of high-risk extremists, forcing authorities to monitor them round the clock, it has emerged.The Home Office is facing outrage after revealing around 170 dangerous foreign nationals cannot be deported from the UK with more than half linked to terrorism or extremist activity, the Sunday Express revealed. item.title: GB News Advent Calendar - Sunday 7th December
item.description: In today's Advent Calendar, we reflect on the importance of a multitude of virtures but one in particular: patience."Now, you can't really understand the message of Christmas without realising that the birth of Jesus was something promised and anticipated for centuries. item.title: Elon Musk hit with major blow as Tesla UK sales drastically decline amid lapsing driver appetite for EVs
item.description: Elon Musk’s Tesla has experienced a significant drop in UK car registrations during November, with figures falling 19 per cent compared to the same month last year. Data from the research group New AutoMotive revealed that 3,784 Tesla vehicles were registered in the UK, down from 4,680 in November 2024.The Society of Motor Manufacturers and Traders recorded a slightly different figure, showing a 17.2 per cent year-on-year decrease to 3,772 units.
